responsibilities.quote: Students shall be considered responsible for the academic integrity of all work they submit for assessment, including group assessments.
All students must ensure that they are aware of, and comply with, University and course requirements and that they are not party to any behaviour which could be construed as academic misconduct.

Where an internal marker suspects that a candidate has breached the Regulations in respect of assessed work other than a formal examination, they should advise the unit leader for the work in question.
responsibilities.anchor: Initial action by internal or external marker
